title: FloorCirculation
description: Route reservations in blueprint XZ, made before furnishing. Sampled endpoints use cellSize; every complete transition is certified against the shared body-radius wall and door-channel model and its permitted room-footprint union. Grounded furniture, including chairs, stays outside the full bodyWidth sweeps, and saved routes are checked against the final furniture. Rendered-mesh collision, larger capsules, accessibility, elevated objects and NPC seat-use approaches are outside this output.

minimumDoorWidth.description: Smallest published room door or 1 m stair channel width on this floor, independent of the body width.

origin.description: Shared circulation route start in the floor spine, not the grid origin.

source.description: Room, door, stair or elevator ID.

maxDisplacement.description: Approaches stay within this radius of their intended point. Room-door approaches stay in their owning room; stair and elevator approaches stay in common transit without a single-room constraint. Null permits a clipped room hub to move only within that room.
